newsitem.title: USA: Cooper Tire completes buy of tire division.
newsitem.headline: Cooper Tire completes buy of tire division.

text.p: Cooper Tire & Rubber Co said Friday it signed an agreement to complete the purchase of Avon Rubber Plc's tire operations for about $110 million.

Cooper will buy the complete rubber tire business; the land and facility in Melksham, England; the shares of Avon Tyres Ltd, the shares of tire distribution companies in France, Germany and Switzerland and other minor assets.
The purchase, which Avon shareholders approved Thursday, also includes various trademarks and technology, the company said.
